CONFIRM C0015 | Evidence from `bench/dm/_convergence.py`: `_compute_equivalence_classes()` merges findings solely when `self.similarity_fn(findings[i], findings[j]) >= self._tau_sim()`. It then assigns `flaw_class = members[0].flaw_class`, so a mixed-class cluster inherits the first member’s class and hides the others. This confirms the mechanism that `flaw_class` is ignored during equivalence comparisons.

CONFIRM C0017 | Evidence from `add_round_findings()`: `round_idx`, `duration`, and `adoption_delta` are stored directly without validation:
`self._round_findings[round_idx] = list(findings)`,
`self._round_durations[round_idx] = duration`,
`self._adoption_deltas[round_idx] = adoption_delta`.
Invalid `duration` values directly affect `_novel_rate()` in `kappa_rate()`; invalid `adoption_delta` affects `kappa_adopt()` before clamping. This confirms unvalidated control input.

A class containing both strongly-suppressed duplicate-like members and weakly-suppressed members is weighted by the least-suppressed member, inflating the whole class’s severity contribution.
